---
title: "Vivacity Exploratory Models"
output: html_document
---

Converted from the original R workflow script so the dissertation repository uses R Markdown workflow artefacts.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(lubridate)
  library(sandwich)
  library(lmtest)
})

base_dir <- "/Users/lu_nanxi/CASA/Dissertation_Data"
modelling_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Vivacity_full_day_cutoff_20260526", "modelling_ready")
table_dir <- file.path(modelling_dir, "tables")
model_dir <- file.path(modelling_dir, "models")
plot_dir <- file.path(model_dir, "plots")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_weekly <- file.path(table_dir, "vivacity_main_causal_weekly_countline.csv")

weekly <- readr::read_csv(
  input_weekly,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    analysis_scheme_id = readr::col_character(),
    scheme_id = readr::col_character(),
    countline_id = readr::col_character()
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    week_start = as_date(week_start),
    intervention_date = as_date(intervention_date),
    first_reliable_date = as_date(first_reliable_date),
    analysis_scheme_id = as.character(analysis_scheme_id),
    countline_id = as.factor(countline_id),
    treated = dataset_role == "treated",
    post = week_start >= intervention_date,
    weeks_since_start = as.numeric(week_start - min(week_start, na.rm = TRUE)) / 7,
    weeks_since_intervention = as.numeric(week_start - intervention_date) / 7,
    post_time_weeks = pmax(0, weeks_since_intervention),
    treated_post = treated & post,
    treated_post_time_weeks = if_else(treated, post_time_weeks, 0),
    week_of_year = isoweek(week_start),
    season_sin = sin(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.1775),
    season_cos = cos(2 * pi * week_of_year / 52.1775)
  )

outcomes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~outcome, ~label,
  "active_per_observed_day", "Active travel",
  "pedestrian_per_observed_day", "Pedestrian",
  "cyclist_per_observed_day", "Cyclist"
)

model_formula <- as.formula(
  log_outcome ~ weeks_since_start + post + post_time_weeks +
    treated_post + treated_post_time_weeks +
    season_sin + season_cos + countline_id
)

fit_one <- function(scheme, outcome, label) {
  dat <- weekly |>
    filter(analysis_scheme_id == scheme) |>
    mutate(
      y_raw = .data[[outcome]],
      log_outcome = log1p(pmax(y_raw, 0)),
      model_weight = pmax(observed_days, 1)
    ) |>
    filter(is.finite(log_outcome), !is.na(intervention_date))

  model <- lm(model_formula, data = dat, weights = model_weight)

  vcov_cluster <- sandwich::vcovCL(model, cluster = dat$countline_id, type = "HC1")
  ct <- lmtest::coeftest(model, vcov. = vcov_cluster)

  coef_tbl <- tibble(
    scheme_id = scheme,
    outcome = outcome,
    outcome_label = label,
    term = rownames(ct),
    estimate = unname(ct[, 1]),
    std_error_cluster = unname(ct[, 2]),
    statistic = unname(ct[, 3]),
    p_value = unname(ct[, 4]),
    percent_change = 100 * (exp(estimate) - 1),
    n_rows = nrow(dat),
    n_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id),
    n_treated_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[dat$treated]),
    n_control_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[!dat$treated]),
    first_week = min(dat$week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_week = max(dat$week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    intervention_date = min(dat$intervention_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  dat_aug <- dat |>
    mutate(
      fitted_log = predict(model, newdata = dat),
      fitted_count = pmax(expm1(fitted_log), 0),
      residual_log = log_outcome - fitted_log,
      scheme_id = scheme,
      outcome = outcome,
      outcome_label = label
    )

  fit_stats <- tibble(
    scheme_id = scheme,
    outcome = outcome,
    outcome_label = label,
    n_rows = nrow(dat),
    n_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id),
    n_treated_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[dat$treated]),
    n_control_countlines = n_distinct(dat$countline_id[!dat$treated]),
    r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
    adj_r_squared = summary(model)$adj.r.squared,
    sigma = summary(model)$sigma,
    first_week = min(dat$week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_week = max(dat$week_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    intervention_date = min(dat$intervention_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  list(coef = coef_tbl, augmented = dat_aug, fit = fit_stats)
}

schemes <- sort(unique(weekly$analysis_scheme_id))

fits <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  scheme = schemes,
  outcome = outcomes$outcome
) |>
  left_join(outcomes, by = "outcome") |>
  mutate(result = purrr::pmap(list(scheme, outcome, label), fit_one))

coef_table <- fits |>
  transmute(data = purrr::map(result, "coef")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(data)

fit_table <- fits |>
  transmute(data = purrr::map(result, "fit")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(data)

augmented <- fits |>
  transmute(data = purrr::map(result, "augmented")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(data)

key_terms <- c("treated_postTRUE", "treated_post_time_weeks")

headline_effects <- coef_table |>
  filter(term %in% key_terms) |>
  mutate(
    interpretation = case_when(
      term == "treated_postTRUE" ~ "Immediate treated-vs-control level change after intervention",
      term == "treated_post_time_weeks" ~ "Additional treated-vs-control weekly slope change after intervention",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "positive_statistically_flagged",
      estimate < 0 & p_value < 0.05 ~ "negative_statistically_flagged",
      estimate > 0 ~ "positive_uncertain",
      estimate < 0 ~ "negative_uncertain",
      TRUE ~ "zero"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    scheme_id, outcome, outcome_label, term, interpretation,
    estimate, std_error_cluster, statistic, p_value, percent_change,
    direction, n_rows, n_countlines, n_treated_countlines, n_control_countlines
  )

weekly_observed_fitted <- augmented |>
  group_by(scheme_id, outcome, outcome_label, dataset_role, role_label, week_start, intervention_date) |>
  summarise(
    observed_countline_days = sum(observed_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    countlines = n_distinct(countline_id),
    observed = weighted.mean(y_raw, w = pmax(observed_days, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
    fitted = weighted.mean(fitted_count, w = pmax(observed_days, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

readr::write_csv(coef_table, file.path(model_dir, "vivacity_exploratory_model_coefficients.csv"))
readr::write_csv(headline_effects, file.path(model_dir, "vivacity_exploratory_headline_effects.csv"))
readr::write_csv(fit_table, file.path(model_dir, "vivacity_exploratory_model_fit_stats.csv"))
readr::write_csv(weekly_observed_fitted, file.path(model_dir, "vivacity_exploratory_weekly_observed_fitted.csv"))

headline_lines <- headline_effects |>
  mutate(
    effect_text = sprintf(
      "- `%s` %s `%s`: %+.2f%%, p = %.3f (%s)",
      scheme_id, outcome_label, term, percent_change, p_value, direction
    )
  ) |>
  pull(effect_text)

plot_one <- function(outcome_name) {
  dat <- weekly_observed_fitted |>
    filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = week_start, colour = role_label)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = observed), alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fitted), linewidth = 0.95) +
    geom_vline(
      data = dat |> distinct(scheme_id, intervention_date),
      aes(xintercept = intervention_date),
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = "grey25"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ scheme_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Treated" = "#1f77b4", "Valid control" = "#d62728")) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(unique(dat$outcome_label), ": observed and fitted weekly trajectories"),
      subtitle = "Thin lines show observed weekly mean per countline-day; thick lines show fitted model values",
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0(unique(dat$outcome_label), " per countline-day"),
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  out_file <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0("model_observed_fitted_", outcome_name, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 180)
}

purrr::walk(outcomes$outcome, plot_one)

summary_lines <- c(
  "# Vivacity Exploratory Treated-Control Models",
  "",
  "## Model Form",
  "",
  "Weekly countline-level weighted OLS models were fitted separately for schemes 12d, 12f, and 13.",
  "",
  "`log1p(outcome_per_observed_day) ~ time + post + post_time + treated_post + treated_post_time + seasonality + countline fixed effects`",
  "",
  "Outcomes: active travel, pedestrian, and cyclist counts per observed countline-day.",
  "",
  "Standard errors are cluster-robust by countline using `sandwich::vcovCL`.",
  "",
  "## Interpretation",
  "",
  "- `treated_postTRUE`: immediate treated-vs-control level change after the intervention month.",
  "- `treated_post_time_weeks`: additional treated-vs-control weekly slope change after intervention.",
  "- Confirmed intervention dates are encoded. Effects remain exploratory because the matched-control pool is limited and concurrent intervention exposure at control sites requires careful interpretation.",
  "",
  "## Outputs",
  "",
  "- `vivacity_exploratory_model_coefficients.csv`",
  "- `vivacity_exploratory_headline_effects.csv`",
  "- `vivacity_exploratory_model_fit_stats.csv`",
  "- `vivacity_exploratory_weekly_observed_fitted.csv`",
  "- `plots/model_observed_fitted_active_per_observed_day.png`",
  "- `plots/model_observed_fitted_pedestrian_per_observed_day.png`",
  "- `plots/model_observed_fitted_cyclist_per_observed_day.png`",
  "",
  "## Headline Treated-Control Terms",
  "",
  headline_lines,
  "",
  "## Caution",
  "",
  "These estimates use the confirmed intervention dates and remain exploratory. They rely on a limited matched-control pool and control sites that require careful interpretation for possible concurrent active travel interventions. Interpret coefficients as evidence about relative trajectories, not definitive causal impacts."
)

writeLines(summary_lines, file.path(model_dir, "README.md"))

message("Wrote exploratory model outputs to: ", model_dir)
```
